note: Per runtime key (Node by major) and e2e build cell: the cell's build time over a honey-free reference build's (packages/core/tests/e2e/build-gate.ts), from the RATIO build lines of the build and prod e2e jobs of CI runs 41577201773, 41578975301, 41580101032, 41581771216, 41583588126, 41585115149 (ci.yml dispatched with build_mode=record). baseline: the median of every job's ratio. ceiling (ceiling-rule.ts ceilingRule): per cell, fit log(ratio) (mean m, sample sd s), sigma_upper = s * sqrt((n-1)/chi2_0.10,n-1) (one-sided 90% upper bound on sigma), z = Phi^-1(1 - 0.02/G) with G = 42 cells, ceiling = max(worst x 1.35, exp(m + z*sigma_upper)), so the cells share a 2% per-run false-red budget. A ratio above its ceiling is REGRESSED. catches: ceiling / baseline. No retry: a red with honey unchanged is answered by a re-record (6+ runs, derived by derive-build-ceilings.ts), never a rerun. The node and bun targets are gone: the bun 1.4 and node 26 keys and every ×bun and ×node cell were dropped without a re-record, and the ×workers cells keep the ceilings recorded (G = 42) while those cells were derived.
